**Which channels are supported as part of <<prodname>> and Contact Center Enterprise integration?**

<<prodname>> and Contact Center Enterprise integration currently supports SMS, Live Chat, and Email  channels. We plan to add more channels soon and this section will be updated as we roll out support for additional channels.
